name: Terraform-Managed DNS and Ansible Infrastructure Setup

mentions.name: Terraform-Managed DNS and Ansible Infrastructure Setup
mentions.description: This project migrates the author's personal infrastructure to a documented, infrastructure-as-code setup: authoritative DNS zones for their domains are now defined in Terraform, and Ansible-based automation for other setups is in progress.
mentions.problem: Previously things were set up ad hoc with little documentation — "For the longest time I just set stuff up and then.... Hoped for the best."
mentions.source_excerpt: Started with my main authoritative DNS for some of my domains today, still working on some Ansible setups but I have the zones down in Terraform now.

evidence.value: Started with my main authoritative DNS for some of my domains today, still working on some Ansible setups but I have the zones down in Terraform now.
